blocker.details: The dev installer calls lima-warm without the required publisher request or Stage-1 authorization; lima-warm fail-closes. The source-derived Stage-1 successor manifest measures five regular no-follow prefix artifacts before post-PM projection; all are absent. The separate AArch64 executor build succeeded externally, but contract fences prohibit manual prefix staging/copying and the macOS installer does not build Linux targets before this point. Native mutation and direct TTY pairing were therefore not started. Supplementary stale fixtures failed as recorded but did not replace the primary blocker.
blocker.handoff_prompt: Bind a fresh evidence nonce only after the source correction is published and independently checked. Re-run from an absent canonical instance/control root; do not reuse this attempt as success or manually stage the external binary into the prefix.
blocker.required_authority: A landed, independently reviewed source correction that adds a canonical manifest-bound pre-Stage-1 staging route for all five Linux artifact roles while retaining external build provenance and no-follow regular-file checks.
blocker.summary: No exact authorized path exists to satisfy the Stage-1 retained-prefix Linux-artifact prerequisite before Stage-1.
